summary: Iteration-6 tested the new homepage hero (MARKETPLACE), banners carousel, notice scheduling, and category icons/colors. Backend: added TestIter6HeroBannersNotice class with 16 pytest cases to /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — all 16 pass. Covered: PUT/GET /api/admin/site admin-only (buyer -> 403), hero update + public reflection + disable, banner image-required (empty image -> 422 via Pydantic min_length=1), SAFE_LINK pattern rejects 'javascript:alert(1)' (422), /api/site returns only enabled banners while /api/admin/site returns all (with ids preserved for welcome/TEST ids), valid banner links (/relative, https://absolute, empty), notice scheduling future starts_at -> active=false, past ends_at -> active=false, ends<=starts -> 400, cleared schedule -> active=true, in-window -> active=true, admin notice_active flag mirrors. Category icon/color persistence (icon='zap', color='#AABBCC'); invalid non-hex color 'red' -> 422; rename-category preserves/updates style and roundtrips. Snapshot of /admin/site taken at setup and restored at teardown; verified via curl: default categories ['Software Licenses','Templates','Digital Assets','Subscriptions','Courses'], hero MARKETPLACE enabled, single 'welcome' banner, notice 'All sales final' starts_at/ends_at null — all restored. Frontend (Playwright viewport 1440x900): shop-hero visible with title 'MARKETPLACE' + subtitle '8 Products Available' + background image; shop-banners carousel renders with shop-banner-welcome linking to /vendors; 6 category tabs rendered (All + 5 cats) with svg icons; selecting Software Licenses tabs it in color rgb(34,211,238) == #22D3EE (matches category_style). Full file list in test_report_links.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py admin_update_site hero branch does not validate `image` URL/path; HeroIn.image is just a 600-char string, so any value (including 'javascript:…' or an empty string) is accepted. Banners enforce SAFE_LINK on `link` only — image urls on both hero and banners are unvalidated. Consider applying SAFE_LINK (or a stricter https?://|/api/files/* pattern) to hero.image and banner.image.

notice_active(n) parses `starts_at`/`ends_at` with datetime.fromisoformat on strings stored by `norm` lambda; the stored value already has tzinfo so comparison is fine. But if a legacy row ever stored a naive ISO string, fromisoformat would return a naive datetime and the `st <= now` comparison would raise. Low risk but worth a tz-safe fallback.

BannerCarousel key uses b.id — DEFAULT_BANNERS 'welcome' id is static. Adding admin UI inserts new ids via new_id(); fine, but note that duplicate ids from admin would silently collide. Admin PUT does not de-dupe banner ids. Low priority.
ShopHero subtitle `.replace('{count}', count)` is a plain string replace — count is a number, which React implicitly stringifies; works, but using String(count) is more explicit.
Marketplace hides the plain 'Shop' heading when hero.enabled=true. Spec says disabling hero should show the plain 'Shop' heading — verified in code (line 44 '(vendor || !hero?.enabled)'). OK.

CategoryIn.icon has no enum/whitelist — any string up to 30 chars is accepted; the frontend CategoryIcon falls back to the Package icon for unknown names, so bad values don't crash but admins could save non-rendering icons.
